instruction.german: Read the sentences in Figure it out and complete the rules in the grammar box.

parts:
Figure it out

Carol is fast. She’s faster than me. She’s the fastest person in the class.

Football is popular in my country. It’s more popular than basketball. It’s the most popular sport.


Grammar | Comparatives and superlatives

We use the comparative and superlative form of adjectives to compare things.

We use comparatives to compare people and things to other people and things. To form the comparative:

• add 1 to short adjectives.

• for longer adjectives, use 2 + adjective.

• remember: use 3 to connect the things we are comparing.

We use superlatives to compare people and things to all the other people and things in the group. To form the superlative:

• add 4 to short adjectives.

• for longer adjectives, use the 5 + adjective.
